parsed_json.up: Select approved drugs with max_phase = 4 and mechanism_of_action classified as CHELATING AGENT. Join molecule_dictionary with drug_mechanism on molregno, then target_dictionary on tid. Include canonical_smiles via INNER JOIN compound_structures. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name.
